name: X-ray absorption, PROV wasGeneratedBy Activity
abstract: Extends cdifProvActivity with XAS-specific provenance: triple-typed activity (schema:Action + xas:analysisevent + prov:Activity), XAS facility location, sample object, XAS instruments via schema:instrument, and XAS additional properties (edge_energy, calibration method, instrument configuration, installedOptions). Defines properties: @type, schema:startTime, schema:endTime, schema:instrument, schema:additionalProperty, schema:location, schema:object. Uses building blocks: cdifProvActivity (cdifDataType), identifier (schemaorgProperties), xasSample (xasProperties), additionalProperty (schemaorgProperties), xasFacility (xasProperties), xasInstrument (xasProperties).
